model: Oracle Database 23ai Free (gvenzl/oracle-free slim image), TNS listener

capture.command:
pscap (scratch Go tool performing internal/portscan Probe's socket IO: one 512-byte banner read with 1.5 s timeout and, when the service stays silent, a second connection attempting a TLS handshake (InsecureSkipVerify; peer chain saved as DER on success); on HTTP ports write 'HEAD / HTTP/1.0
Host: <host>

' first; on TLS-first ports outside the web list (636, 6443, 10250) only the handshake, nothing written or read); run from the lab manager container fxlab-k-mgr (alpine:3.20) on the fxlab-k bridge: pscap -host <container> -port <port> -mode <banner|http|tls-silent> -name <port>-<service>

files.name: 1521-oracle.banner
files.description: raw bytes the service sent (what Probe's banner read returns before printable()); empty when the service waits for the client

files.name: 1521-oracle.json
files.description: capture record: host, port, mode, byte count, TLS outcome and error, chain files

notes: Captured after 'DATABASE IS READY TO USE!', with the other lab services already removed (the address 192.168.112.2 was reused). ORACLE_PASSWORD random and not recorded. TNS is client-first (CONNECT packet): empty banner, the TLS retry was closed (EOF).
